Iron deficiency anemia is characterized by a range of symptoms that can vary depending on the severity and underlying causes. Some common symptoms include:

* Fatigue
* Weakness
* Pale skin
* Shortness of breath
* Cold hands and feet
* Brittle nails
* Unusual cravings for non-food items
* Heavy menstrual periods (in women)
* Restless leg syndrome

These symptoms can be influenced by factors such as low iron levels, inadequate dietary intake, or underlying medical conditions. Blood tests are commonly used to confirm the diagnosis of iron deficiency anemia and determine potential underlying causes.

It is essential to seek medical attention if you experience any of these symptoms, as iron deficiency anemia can lead to more severe health complications if left untreated.
